title: The Idlewild riverboat job
summary: After the Young Tuxedo Band, they played the Idlewild steamer in 1927.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: So where did you go up to the Young Tuxedo Band? Who did you play with after you remember that? When I left the Young Tuxedo Band? Yeah.
Well, that's the Young Tuxedo Band until that band. We were, everybody just scattered out, let's see.

Young Tuxedo Band, we went into, well, you could call that, we even went on the boat in 1927 to play the boat, they call it, used to run for the colored, called the Idlewild. Used to live in the podium in the river. Yeah. It was owned by, let me see, some real estate people now. You had that there in the steamer capital in the present, you know, it was called steamer capital that time before the Canal Street. And they used to run this boat from the podium in the river. Oh, yeah. And that was, Tuxedo gave us that job. But Walter T. T. Rebue used to be on Oysalon and, Oysalon and Boivin, I believe, Carpestore people. Yeah. And them people had that boat in charge. Uh-huh.
Yeah, boat run there a good while.
It was something like this River Queen you got, you know.
Did you ever go to New York anywhere with the bands? No, I went to New York.
What did you go after this boat? Do you remember who you played with after? Yeah, boat, yeah.
